correctness.rationale: Fixed nonsplit Q over F2 has 9-dim anticanonical space/511 nonzero sections. Exact four-chart characteristic-two Gröbner smoothness criterion independently returns 240 smooth masks and 4020 all-smooth 2-planes. Independent full GF2 automorphism enumeration returns group order 120 and 36 pencil orbits; independent Jacobian unit-ideal tests of every orbit representative confirm counts of reduced bases by rational base-point stratum. Ovoid five rational points, 15 reducible kernel quadrics and f+g argument give universal b<=3; explicit masks 34/202 attain and elimination irreducible quintic gives (1,1,1,5). Fixed finite enumeration is exhaustive due to exact unit-ideal criteria, not sampling extensions.
